title: Accrual-Based and Real Earnings Management Activities Around Seasoned Equity Offerings
sources_checked: Local project resource catalog: output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json; generated 2026-10-27; lists the three exact local SAS datasets named by the accepted construction.

COMP.FUNDA: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat; local file mtime 2026-07-22; bounded field and annual-coverage check found standardized FY2012 support (8,253 rows; DATADATE 2012-06-30 to 2013-05-31), needed for offer-year 2011 outcomes.

SDC.WRDS_NI_DETAILS: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/tfn/sdc_ni/wrds_ni_details.sas7bdat; local file mtime 2025-12-04; source-date and accepted-screen checks found offers in each requested year 2007–2011 (264, 162, 351, 319, 238 pre-Compustat-link candidates).

COMP.SEC_IDHIST: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/security/sec_idhist.sas7bdat; local file mtime 2026-08-14; 60,163 CUSIP histories overlap 2007–2011; the accepted effective-date CUSIP preference produced 1,313 unique links, 21 unlinked candidates, and no ambiguous links among 1,334 screened added-period events.

Accepted and fresh Stata handoff metadata only: predecessor output/reproductions/packages/W3123227524/attempt_02/data/seo_earnings_mgmt/reg.dta had 2,070 rows; the fresh work/data/seo_earnings_mgmt/reg.dta has 2,593 rows. Both use MASTER_DEAL_NO as string key, offer_year int16, MASTER_DEAL_DATE int16 without Stata date display format, and double-valued analysis variables.

Accepted comparison outputs: output/reproductions/packages/W3123227524/attempt_02/tables/table6_{a_col6,b_col7,c_col7,d_col7,e_col7,f_col7}.csv; these save the six original pooled-window focal estimates at three decimals.
changes: Extend the event observation clock from issue-year 1987–2006 to 1987–2011, preserving the original start and the accepted calendar-year/FYEAR mapping. Extend COMP.FUNDA input from FY2007 through FY2012 so year-1 outcomes for the 2011 offer cohort are available; extend the SDC and SEC_IDHIST date bounds through 2011.

Retain the accepted screen, event-grain construction, matching, proxy equations, annual cross-sections, Fama–MacBeth estimator, regressors, covariance defaults, and output table specification. No substitute source or generated observations are used.

Add e(sample)-based event counts and the computed EXT_SAMPLE line to each accepted Stata fit, plus one fresh aggregate CSV under work/artifacts per fit. Existing four table exports remain under work/tables.
Reviewed the relocated Stata ado path: it resolves from work/ to the published output/reproductions/resources/ado directory, so no path correction was needed.
limitations: The paper does not specify the year-0 sales-growth or capex-growth formulas, Table 6 constant convention, ROA matching period, tie rule, or event-to-fiscal-year alignment; the accepted best-effort choices documented in work/design.md are retained.

The local SDC schema lacks exact deal-category codes for several exclusions. Description/business text approximates rights and standby issues, units, funds, and reverse LBOs; completion is proxied by an issue date with no postponed/withdrawn dates. The source sample has 1,511 offers; the predecessor local sample has 2,070 event-grain offers from 1987–2006. These differences are not tuned away.

The paper requires four annual statements before filing and data for its DA/RM measures. The accepted construction operationalizes the statement criterion as the four latest consecutive pre-filing FYEAR labels and uses a common issuer year-0 screen requiring all six proxy measures. The accepted limitations and possible sample effects remain.

Dated SEC_IDHIST links select one GVKEY for 5,114 of 5,249 original target SDC offers; 134 lacked a dated Compustat link and one was ambiguous in the accepted window. The added-window preflight had 21 unlinked and no ambiguous screened candidates; source-link attrition remains.

The paper reports Fama–MacBeth results; the accepted table also reports an equal-weighted mean of annual OLS adjusted R-squared in percent units, while the xtfmb average unadjusted R-squared is a separate fraction. Two-sided p-values are the accepted template presentation.
The local catalog does not state a vendor delivery date for SDC; the local SDC file mtime is recorded as the available vintage indicator, and in-window event dates were verified directly.

analyses.label: Table 6 Panel A, column [6]: adjusted year-1 ROA change on year-0 discretionary accruals and sales/capex growth
analyses.reason: Fresh pooled replay of the previously executed Panel A, column [6] fit on offer-years 1987–2011. The active Fama–MacBeth e(sample) contains 2,030 event observations from 1987–2006 and 509 from 2007–2011 (2,539 total); the last contributing offer year is 2011. Compustat and dated SDC/SEC_IDHIST coverage support the requested endpoint, and SAS confirms 25 full-rank annual cross-sections. The focal Discretionary accruals coefficient is -0.055 (two-sided p=0.295) versus -0.066 (p=0.313) in the saved accepted reproduction.
source_evidence: Paper Table 6 Table 6 Panel A, column [6], pp. 15–16; output/models/records/W3123227524.json identifies the matching result set.
